what: Neurocrine Biosciences develops medicines for neurological and endocrine disorders. Ingrezza, for the involuntary movement disorder tardive dyskinesia, is its main product, and it has newer medicines for congenital adrenal hyperplasia and endometriosis.
customers: Psychiatrists, neurologists and endocrinologists, with treatment paid for by insurers and Medicaid.
money: treatment for tardive dyskinesia and Huntington's chorea
congenital adrenal hyperplasia treatment and partnered royalties
moat: A medicine that has become the standard treatment in a condition caused by long-term antipsychotic use, with a prescriber base that is concentrated and well understood.
risks: Most revenue comes from one medicine
Medicaid and insurer pricing pressure affects a product largely paid for by government programmes
Patent challenges to Ingrezza would be significant
opportunities: Gross margin of 98% with a 22% operating margin
Revenue grew about 21% last year and about 24% a year over three years
Analysts see about 32% upside, with new products diversifying the revenue base
watch: Ingrezza prescription growth and the Crenessity launch.
